slides: Welcome back. Now type two of trial and error, minimum and maximum.

slides.say: Minimum and maximum questions are about ranges. What's the smallest possible value, and what's the biggest?
Unlike general problems, we don't try blindly. A little understanding tells us which way to push, toward the smallest or toward the biggest. So we need far fewer tries.
at: tells us which way to push

slides.say: By the way, minimum and maximum isn't only this lesson. It comes back all over the quantitative section. In geometry, in overlap problems later on, and in many other questions. So the thinking we build here pays off again and again.

slides: Let's see a question of this type. [pause] I'll see you in the next video.
